## Final checkpoint

**PR:** https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/66 (pushed, on `worker/task-20260725-080900-owner-engine-mandatory-gate-implementati`)

**Shipped:** `task-gateway.py submit` now defaults `--source owner` text through `gateway.py` before instruction creation (real-tested, sqlite proof included); `scripts/prompt_gateway/query.py` machine-language query interface with a real `NEEDS_OWNER_CLARIFICATION` decision procedure; `ai-os/OWNER_ENGINE_MACHINE_LANGUAGE_CONTRACT_2026-07-25.yaml` proven on a real retrofit of the `lookup-capability` call site; full documentation + MASTER_INDEX + knowledge-engine registration.

**Drafted one-line Owner trigger phrase** (tested end-to-end, not yet handed to the Owner — that handoff happens separately per this task's own instructions):
> "OWNER_ENGINE_GATE: do not read this chat raw -- run it through scripts/prompt_gateway/gateway.py (OWNER_ENGINE, SUPERBOSS) via task-gateway.py submit --source owner first, then work only from its output prompt."

**Honest 19-point breakdown** (full detail in `ai-os/OWNER_ENGINE_MANDATORY_GATE_IMPLEMENTATION_2026-07-25.yaml`):
- **Code-enforced (2):** points 2, 3 — the gate + query interface + decision procedure
- **Code-enforced, proof-of-concept scope only (6):** points 4, 5, 14, 15, 17, 19 — the machine-language contract exists and works on 2 real call sites, not retrofitted codebase-wide
- **Discipline-only, no reachable code boundary (11):** points 1, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 16, 18 — session/host identity, Owner-facing conversational style, AI's own model I/O, and AI-to-AI channels (none exist yet to gate) are outside anything this task's code can enforce

One pre-existing, unrelated bug noted honestly in the doc: `task-gateway.py`'s keyword-extraction regex mismatches on apostrophes in contractions (e.g. "it's"/"you're"), producing garbled keyword strings — confirmed pre-existing, not introduced by this change, left unfixed as out of scope.
